parts.text:
CHARGE NO: {{chargeNumber}}
BETWEEN:
{{complainant}} .................... COMPLAINANT
AND
{{defendant}} .................... DEFENDANT
parts.why: Heading, charge number and parties. Name every defendant in full (with any alias or title given); a person not arrested cannot be tried in absentia and is not made a party. Use 'Defendant', never 'Accused'. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: The {{complainant}} charges the defendant(s) as follows:
parts.why: The preamble introducing the counts. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.instruction: Draft the counts of the charge from the facts given. Head each 'COUNT 1', 'COUNT 2' and so on. Each count has a 'STATEMENT OF OFFENCE' naming the offence and the section of the law that creates it and punishes it, and 'PARTICULARS OF OFFENCE' stating, in one sentence: the defendant's full name, the date, the place 'within the jurisdiction of this Honourable Court', the act, the property or person, and the owner or victim last. One offence per count; charge conspiracy as 'Conspiracy to commit the offence of …'. Use only offences and sections the facts and the library support.
parts.why: The counts: each with a statement of offence (the offence and its section) and particulars (who, when, where, what, against whom). One offence per count; the victim comes last; time, value or relationship must be stated where they matter. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
